video_title: Door Open For LeBron To Leave Lakers?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers are actively looking to sign a starting center in free agency
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers are involved in trade talks to use their space. They are trying to sign a center.
quotes.quote: The Lakers are involved in trade talks to use their space. Starting Monday, you are going to see the Lakers try to sign a center. There are a couple of options out there. Robert Williams is out there coming off the Blazers, Mitchell Robinson is obviously out there if the Knicks are not going to go to the second apron to keep him, and Yusuf Nurkic is unrestricted. These are guys who can be your starting center. All of them have questions attached, but the Lakers are out there. I think they can be active in free agency in that regard.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers reached out to LeBron James's representative, but no further talks have occurred
quotes.excerpt: They reached out to LeBron's representative to Rich Paul and said, we'd like to have LeBron back.
quotes.quote: As soon as the finals ended, they had a meeting with Austin Reaves and began the contract negotiations and ended up leading to him signing to stay, to bypass free agency and stay. And they reached out to LeBron to LeBron's representative to Rich Paul and said, we'd like to have LeBron back. But there have been no further talks. And from what I understand, the Lakers have not made an offer, but LeBron, from what I understand, as of today when I got this update, LeBron has not made himself available to meet with the Lakers yet.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's first step is deciding if he is playing next year
quotes.excerpt: The first step in this is that LeBron has to decide he's playing next year.
quotes.quote: What I have been saying for quite some time now is the first step in this is that LeBron has to decide he's playing next year. LeBron has his own process. Maybe he gets in front of the Lakers and there is a formal contract offer in the next 24 hours. Maybe it doesn't happen. But naturally, the Lakers, if they can't get some sort of commitment from LeBron or they don't make an offer or whatever, they are going to have to move on with business. And that might mean that LeBron is limiting the money that he can make.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James prioritizes happiness over money for next season
quotes.excerpt: The number one thing for LeBron next season is happiness, not money.
quotes.quote: It has been communicated to me that the number one thing for LeBron next season is happiness, not money. Obviously, we knew that he is going to have to take a pay cut from 50 million. So that has been communicated to me. And what does that mean? I don't know. Does that mean he is willing to take the mid-level? Does that mean he is willing to take the taxpayer mid-level? I don't know what that means, but that is what I have to offer as we hit as we are on June 28th.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Rich Paul's message to the Lakers regarding their pursuit of LeBron
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers are not and will not annoy us.
quotes.quote: I have clearance to use this quote attributed to Rich Paul. The Lakers are not and will not annoy us. That is the conclusion of the quote. In other words, the reason I am saying that now, Vinnie, is like what he is saying is we are not annoyed. We are not annoyed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is likely to pick up his player option
quotes.excerpt: I think it is very likely that they are going to pick up that option.
quotes.quote: Tomorrow, LeBron James has a guaranteed date in his contract. His contract is partially guaranteed. Now it is guaranteed for 1.2 million right now, and if they pick up the option it is 2.2 million. I think it is very likely that they are going to pick up that option because Bronny had an increased role going down the stretch of the season. Having said that, I do think that is something that at least is worth keeping an eye on about whether about picking up Bronny or not.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green is likely to pick up his player option
quotes.excerpt: It is likely that Draymond will pick that contract option up.
quotes.quote: On Monday, Draymond Green has a 27 million dollar player option in his contract. It is likely that Draymond will pick that contract option up. And listen, if he doesn't pick it up, it doesn't necessarily mean that LeBron would be going to the Warriors. However, if Draymond, who is represented by Rich Paul and is close to LeBron, if Draymond passes on that contract option, the possibility exists of him taking less money and him taking money in a spot that can give the Warriors a pathway to get the 15 million dollar full mid-level.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green opting out could create financial flexibility for the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: If Draymond does not pick up that option, it opens the window for more things to happen.
quotes.quote: I am not saying if Draymond does not pick up that option that it means LeBron is going there. But if Draymond does not pick up that option, as a clutch client close to LeBron, it opens the window for more things to happen with their salary books. So those are two things that could happen. I am not sure we are going to get an answer from LeBron on Monday or Tuesday, but we may get an answer on what happens with Bronny.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for a star player often depletes a team's depth
quotes.excerpt: The consequence of clearing out cap space is that you deplete your team.
quotes.quote: The thing about it is just like when you trade a star player, frequently they are not ready to go right away. The consequence of clearing out cap space is that you deplete your team. So just like we say that the Heat are probably a year away maybe from recovering from everything they gave away in this deal, the Lakers clearing down their cap space would require some recovery.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is not desperate for a new contract
quotes.excerpt: One thing I will say about LeBron, he is not desperate.
quotes.quote: One thing I will say about LeBron, he is not desperate. He is going to have options, especially if he is not worried about every dollar, which it sounds like he is not.
